spells.name: Swollen Form
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick a visible friendly fighter within 9" of the caster to be the target. That fighter is *swollen* until the end of the round. While a fighter is *swollen*, they can ignore the first 3 points of damage they suffer.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range to 12"

spells.name: Black Mire
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

Pick a visible point on the battlefield floor within 6" of the caster. Until the end of the round, the battlefield floor within 6" of that point is a *mire*. Subtract 2 from the maximum distance a non-*Cloister* fighter can move each time they move across the mire.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** The battlefield floor within 9" of that point is a *mire*, instead of 6".

spells.name: Erupting Sores
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

The closest visible enemy fighter within 9" is targeted and suffers d3 damage. If they are not taken down, they must pass a Willpower test, else scatter d6".

**Critical Cast [12+]:** Increase the range to 12"

spells.name: Rain of Filth
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Place the blast template centred on a point within 12" of the caster, it then scatters d6".

Each fighter in the template is targeted and heals d3 life.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** It does not scatter.

spells.name: Putrid Blessing
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

Pick a friendly fighter within 6" of the casting fighter to be the target,. That fighter has a *putrid blessing* until the end of the round. While a fighter has a *putrid blessing*, their Melee Weapons gain the *Arcane* and *Poison* weapon traits.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range of the spell from 6" to 12".

spells.name: Black Bile
spells.text:
**Casting Value [9+]**

Place the flame template from the caster. Each fighter in the template is targeted and hit with the following attack:

Rend -1, Damage d3.

**Critical Cast [14+]:** Each fighter hit by the attack must pass a Willpower test else they become *poisoned*, (see the *Poison* weapon trait).

spells.name: Summon Rotling
spells.text:
**Casting Value [9+]**

A *summoned* Rotling fighter, is added to the caster's warband until it is taken down. Set up the fighter within 3" of the caster and not engaged in melee.

A warband cannot have more than 3 *summoned* fighters at any time. If the caster's warband already has 3 *summoned* fighters, they cannot cast this spell.

**Critical Cast [14+]:** The fighter can be set up within 9" of the caster and not engaged in melee.

spells.name: Demonic Strength
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

Pick a friendly *Demon* or *Beastman* fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target. That fighter has *demonic strength* until the end of the round. While a fighter has *demonic strength*, add 1 to the Damage and Critical Damage values of their Melee Weapons.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** You can pick 2 fighters to be targets instead of 1.

spells.name: Rotten Insides
spells.text:
**Casting Value [6+]**

The closest visible enemy fighter within 9" is targeted and suffers 1 damage. If they are not taken down, they have *rotten insides*. While a fighter has *rotten insides* their Move value is 2". At the end of a fighter with *rotten insides's* activation they take a Willpower test. If they pass, they no longer have rotten insides.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** Increase the range to 12"

spells.name: Plague Wind
spells.text:
**Casting Value [6+]**

Place the blast template centred on a point within 15" of the caster. Each enemy fighter in the template is targeted and must pass a Willpower test else they become *poisoned*, (see the *Poison* weapon trait).

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Subtract 1 from any Willpower tests made for this spell.

spells.name: Protective Shroud
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

Pick a friendly *Demon* or *Beastman* fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target. That fighter has a *protective shroud* until the end of the round. While a fighter has *protective shroud*, improve their Armour value by 1.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** Increase the range to 12"

spells.name: Plague Pit
spells.text:
**Casting Value [9+]**

Place the blast template centred on a visible point on the battlefield floor within 9" of the caster. A pit opens here. In an order chosen by the commanding player of the caster, each fighter in the template is removed from the battlefield and set up again at the edge of the pit by its commanding player, not engaged in melee. If there is no space, they are set up as close to the edge of the pit as possible, not engaged in melee.

After being set up, the fighter must pass an Initiative test else suffer d3 damage and become *poisoned* (see the Poison weapon trait).

The pit remains in play until the end of the round. Fighters cannot move across the pit while they are on the battlefield floor. Any treasure tokens on the pit are destroyed.

**Critical Cast [14+]:** Increase the range from 9" to 12".
